The records are structured as a continuous sequence of 9,244 entries, each containing a unique identifier, a repeating four-word phrase, and a numerical suffix. The four-word phrases cycle through a fixed set of twelve distinct combinations in a consistent, repeating order throughout the dataset. The numerical suffix at the end of each record increments sequentially from 0 to 96, resetting to 0 after reaching 96 to create a looping pattern.
